column5: Audited FY19-FY24 Financial Bridge

FY24 Organic +2.2% (RIG +1.4%, Pricing +0.8%); 5Y Reported Delta -1.22B CHF driven by net divestitures & FX (-14.2B CHF: divested Skin Health CHF 10.2B, US Water CHF 4.3B, Yinlu; acquired Bountiful $5.75B).
5Y Net Revenue +$24.69B (+36.8%); driven by cumulative net pricing realization (+31% across 2021-2024) and International revenue scaling to $37.0B (40% of total sales, 10% 5Y core EBIT CAGR).
5Y Net Revenue +$10.57B (+40.9%); driven by organic pricing to offset record 2023-2024 cocoa inflation plus bolt-on M&A: Clif Bar ($2.9B), Ricolino ($1.3B), Chipita ($2.0B), and Give & Go.
5Y Reported Revenue +2.09B EUR (+8.3%); FY24 LFL +4.3% (Volume/Mix +3.0%, Price +1.3%). Reported top-line tempered by Russia EDP deconsolidation and Horizon Organic/Wallaby divestiture.
5Y Revenue +$0.87B; divested Planters ($3.35B) and Natural Cheese ($3.2B) to reduce net leverage from 4.4x to 3.0x; FY24 Organic Net Sales -2.1% (Price +1.4%, Volume/Mix -3.5%).

5Y Revenue +$2.99B (+17.7%); driven by 'Accelerate' portfolio reshaping (divested European Yoplait & Helper/Suddenly Salad; acquired Tyson Pet Treats $1.2B) and $1B+ Holistic Margin Management (HMM) savings.

5Y Grocery & Ingredients Revenue +£1.58B (+31.7%; Group F&B incl. Sugar £9.4B); FY24 Grocery Adj. Operating Profit rose +17% to £511M driven by Twinings, Ovaltine, and US specialty brands (Mazola, Acetum).
5Y Revenue +2.40B EUR (+12.4%) despite divesting ekaterra Tea (€4.5B in 2022); FY24 Nutrition €13.4B (USG +2.9%, UOM 20.3%) and Ice Cream €8.3B (USG +3.7%, UOM 13.9%).
5Y Continuing Ops Revenue +$1.53B (+18.9%); completed Sovos Brands acquisition ($2.7B in March 2024) adding Rao's Homemade ($1B+ run-rate) and delivered $950M+ multi-year cost savings.
5Y Revenue +$2.51B (+26.3%) reflecting full Pinnacle Foods integration ($10.9B deal); FY24 organic net sales -2.1% (Volume -1.9%, Price/Mix -0.2%) offset by +310 bps supply chain productivity.

Japanese Revenue Recognition Standard adoption (FY2021) reduced reported top line optically; Food segment JPY 901.6B (FY24/25: JPY 942.8B, OI JPY 68.7B) driven by multi-wave dairy/chocolate price revisions.
US Business (Hi-Chew) surged >3x over 5 years to JPY 19.8B+ alongside domestic 'in Jelly' functional nutritional drink volume growth (+8.4% YoY); FY24/25 revenue reached JPY 228.5B.
5Y Consolidated Revenue +KRW 7,007B (+31.3%); Food Division grew +41.7% (from KRW 8,010B to KRW 11,353B) propelled by Schwan's Company US integration and Bibigo Global Strategic Products (GSP).

5Y Statutory Revenue +KRW 1,951B (+93.2%) driven by July 2022 merger of Lotte Confectionery and Lotte Food (~KRW 1.7T added) plus India subsidiaries (Havmor Ice Cream + Lotte India) growing +11.6% YoY.
5Y Revenue +KRW 1,294B (+43.7%); driven by global Jongga Kimchi exports (reaching $94M+ across 60 countries, US factory operational in Los Angeles) and starch/lysine bio recovery in FY24.
5Y Continuing Revenue +PHP 27.71B (+20.7%); divested Oceania (Griffin's/Snack Brands Australia) in 2019-2021 to recycle capital into Munchy's Malaysia acquisition (MYR 1.925B) and domestic BCF.
5Y Consolidated Revenue +PHP 90.11B (+29.0%); San Miguel Foods division grew +32.8% (from PHP 139.5B to PHP 185.2B) via prepared/packaged foods (Purefoods, Magnolia, Star) and mega-poultry plants.

5Y Revenue +SGD 260M (+13.7%); Dairies segment contributed 58% of Group PBIT, supported by F&N Dairies Thailand canned milk share and 100% buyout of Cocoaland Holdings (Malaysia confectionery) in 2022.
5Y Revenue +MYR 700M (+12.7%); grew steadily to a peak of MYR 7.05B in FY2023 before experiencing a -11.7% domestic revenue contraction in FY2024 due to consumer boycotts and cocoa/coffee inflation.

5Y Revenue +THB 4.91B (+20.0%); driven by high-margin MAMA OK premium oriental noodles (THB 15/pack vs THB 6/7 base), President Bakery (Farmhouse bread) expansion, and 2023-24 palm oil/wheat moderation.

column2: PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk
column5: 5Y Revenue +IDR 30.30T (+71.6%); propelled by $2.99B Pinehill Company Ltd acquisition (Aug 2020, adding 20+ plants across Africa/Middle East/SE Europe) plus domestic noodle EBIT margin reaching 26.8%.

5Y Revenue +IDR 39.20T (+51.2%); driven by CBP division (+71.6%) and Bogasari flour milling (IDR 29.8T gross sales) passing through wheat cycles while Agribusiness CPO lifted consolidated EBIT margin by +680 bps.

5Y Revenue +IDR 11.04T (+44.1%); FY24 top line surged +14.6% YoY on +12% physical volume growth, though FY24 Gross Margin compressed from 26.7% to 23.0% due to historic coffee bean and cocoa cost spikes.
5Y Revenue increased 6.5x (+IDR 7.64T); Dairy reached IDR 3.95T and Premium Consumer Foods (Kanzler single-serve sausages/nuggets) reached IDR 5.08T, expanding Gross Margin to 45.1%.

column2: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Co. Tbk
column5: 5Y Revenue +IDR 2.63T (+42.1%); Dairy segment contributed 77% of revenue and RTD Tea (Teh Kotak) 19%; commissioned new automated distribution center and dairy farm capacity in Bandung/Sumatra.

column2: PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
column5: 5Y Revenue +IDR 3.80T (+45.0%); propelled by Mulino (Prochiz cheddar cheese) acquisition in Oct 2020 and Hormel Foods JV alongside snack/biscuit distribution integration across GT channels.

5Y Revenue +IDR 1.44T (+41.0%) while Operating Profit surged +132% to IDR 1.37T; driven by strict SKU rationalization in extruded snacks/crackers, multi-island plant proximity (Sidoarjo, Medan, Bekasi), and <3% A&P ratio.

5Y Revenue +IDR 0.59T (+17.7%); exited loss-making Philippines JV in 2020 to focus on 14 domestic bakery plants (Banjarmasin, Pekanbaru added) plus Sari Choco chocolate milk and jam spreads, lowering return rates.

5Y Revenue +IDR 2.76T (+40.3%); cold-chain logistics fleet (1,000+ refrigerated trucks) and 24+ distribution hubs enabled rapid B2B foodservice and B2C retail scale in refrigerated dairy (Diamond, Brookfarm) and meats.

5Y Revenue +IDR 0.41T (+27.2%) and EBIT Margin swung +850 bps (from -2.1% to +6.4%); post-2020 FKS Group equity injection and PKPU debt restructuring restored working capital for Taro, Mie Kremezz, and Bihunku.

5Y Revenue +RMB 25.56B (+28.3%); acquired Ausnutria Dairy (2022) driving infant formula & adult milk powder to #1 domestic share (+7.5% YoY in FY24 to RMB 29.7B), offsetting -8.2% FY24 liquid milk channel destocking.

5Y Revenue +RMB 9.64B (+12.2%) despite -10.1% FY24 revenue contraction; raw milk cost deflation lifted FY24 Gross Margin by +240 bps to 39.6% and OP margin +190 bps to 8.2%, while Bellamy's goodwill impairment hit statutory net profit (RMB 104.5M).

5Y Revenue +RMB 18.67B (+30.1%); Beverages scaled to RMB 51.62B (+1.3% YoY) and Instant Noodles reached RMB 28.41B; FY24 Gross Margin expanded +270 bps to 33.1% via palm oil/sugar easing and 500ml RTD tea price hike (from RMB 3 to RMB 3.5).

5Y Revenue +RMB 8.31B (+37.7%; Parent 1216.TW reached TWD 657.64B, +7.98% CAGR); Beverage revenue hit RMB 19.24B (+8.2% YoY in FY24 led by Uni Iced Tea, Green Tea & Haizhiyan) and Food hit RMB 9.99B (Tang Daren & The King of Tomato).

5Y Revenue +RMB 3.42B (+17.0%); Hot-Kid Milk dairy/beverages reached RMB 11.95B (50.8% of total revenue) alongside rice crackers/candies; emerging channels (bulk snack discount chains, vending, OEM) exceeded 10% of revenue.

5Y Revenue +RMB 1.72B (+7.6%); consolidated New Zealand subsidiary Synlait Milk (recapitalized in 2024) while defending East China/Shanghai fresh pasteurized milk and cold-chain yogurt (Momchilovtsi) share against national UHT discounting.

V-Shaped Channel Re-Engineering: Revenue fell from RMB 10.17B (2019) to RMB 7.11B (2023) due to Tmall traffic decay and store closures, then surged +49.3% YoY in FY24 to RMB 10.62B via 'High-End Cost-Performance' pricing and in-house nut factories.

5Y Revenue +RMB 2.89B (+85.5%); Vegetable snack products (Konjac Shuang & Fengchi Kelp) surged +59% YoY in FY24 to surpass seasoned flour (Latiao) as the #1 revenue contributor, paired with bulk snack discount chain distribution.

5Y Revenue -RMB 0.66B (-8.6%); executed a historic -22% average price reduction (up to -45%) across 300+ core SKUs in Nov 2023-2024 to defend traffic against pure-play discount snack chains, compressing FY24 gross margin by -260 bps.

5Y Revenue -HKD 1.31B (-17.4%) following the July 2021 Mainland China consumer boycott (Mainland revenue dropped from HKD 5.0B peak to HKD 3.3B); FY23/24 and H1 FY24/25 profitability recovering via Mainland trade-spend discipline and dominant HK operations.
